title: Director of Engineering
description:
**Job Title: Director of Engineering**

**About the Role**

Dash Technologies is a US-headquartered software services company building AI-first solutions for healthcare and enterprise clients. We are looking for a Director of Engineering who can lead both technical engineering excellence and delivery execution in a fast-paced services environment with deep fluency in the US healthcare ecosystem.

This is the senior-most engineering and delivery role in the organization. It reports directly to the CEO, and the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 30-40 team members (direct and indirect reports) reports into this role, including 5-10 US-based team members managed remotely from India. The role owns a portfolio of approximately 20 customers, of which five are blue-chip accounts requiring direct engagement with client CEOs and CIOs. The portfolio is approximately 70% US healthcare engagements and 30% other technology engagements.

This role is a member of the company's leadership team and participates in all monthly and quarterly business reviews. This is not a 9-to-5 job it demands an always-on ownership mindset, with genuine care for customers and an unwavering commitment to delivery.

This role is responsible for building AI-first engineering capabilities while ensuring high-quality, predictable delivery across multiple US client engagements. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineering leader with strong delivery discipline, proven US healthcare domain experience, and exceptional people and client management skills the ability to build genuine, lasting relationships with team members, clients, and senior client executives is mandatory for success in this role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Engineering Leadership**

* + Lead the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 60 direct and indirect reports, including engineering managers, tech leads, and delivery teams
  + Directly manage 5–10 US-based team members from India, ensuring cohesion, accountability, and performance across geographies
  + Lead architecture, design, and development of scalable, secure, high-quality software systems
  + Establish and enforce engineering best practices across teams
  + Mentor engineering managers, tech leads, and senior developers
  + Ensure strong code quality, system performance, and reliability

**Healthcare Domain Leadership**

* + Bring a working understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain providers, payers, MedTech, digital health, and life sciences
  + Guide teams building on and integrating with EMR/EHR platforms or any strong compliance domain experience.

**AI & Innovation**

* + Drive adoption of AI/ML, LLMs, and intelligent automation across projects, including healthcare-specific AI use cases
  + Build reusable AI accelerators and frameworks to improve delivery efficiency
  + Enable teams to leverage AI-assisted development tools
  + Partner with leadership to define and execute AI-driven service offerings

**Delivery Ownership**

* + Own end-to-end delivery across multiple US client projects
  + Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality
  + Implement strong execution frameworks (Agile, sprint discipline, milestone tracking)
  + Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and escalations

**Stakeholder & Relationship Management**

* + Own and manage a portfolio of approximately 5 customers, including five blue-chip accounts requiring direct interaction with client CIOs & CTOs and proactive expectation management
  + Act as the key interface between US clients, engineering teams, and the CEO
  + Build genuine personal relationships with clients and client executives (C-level and senior officers) relationship-building and client management skills are mandatory
  + Participate in all monthly and quarterly business review meetings as a member of the leadership team
  + Travel to the US frequently (2–3 times per year) for client meetings, executive reviews, and relationship development
  + Communicate technical and healthcare-domain concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  + Build strong client relationships and ensure high satisfaction

**Resource Management**

* + Allocate and optimize engineering resources across projects
  + Ensure the right skills are aligned to the right work
  + Drive high utilization while supporting team growth and development
  + Partner with HR and leadership on hiring and capacity planning
  + Own hiring and establish a structured training and academy program to keep building a new pipeline of talent

**Operational & Financial Excellence**

* + Own delivery metrics including velocity, quality, utilization, and timelines
  + Maintain a strong focus on delivery efficiency and project margins
  + Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization
  + Support business growth through better delivery capability and client outcomes

**Qualifications**

* + Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred)
  + 15–20 years of experience in software engineering and delivery management within a software services or product development environment
  + Demonstrated experience delivering software for US healthcare clients providers, payers, MedTech, or digital health companies
  + Strong understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain, including EMR/EHR ecosystems, interoperability (HL7/FHIR), HIPAA/PHI compliance, and clinical and operational workflows
  + Proven track record of successfully managing multiple concurrent software projects for US-based clients
  + Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and AI-assisted development practices
  + Must already be a heavy, daily user of AI tools in their own work — hands-on, everyday AI use is expected from day one (mandatory)
  + Strong understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall)
  + Experience working with cross-functional teams including developers, QA, product management, and operations
  + Experience managing US-based team members remotely from India (mandatory)
  + Excellent leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills — proven ability to build and retain high-performing teams (mandatory)
  + Exceptional relationship-building and client management skills, including comfort engaging directly with C-level client executives (CEOs, CIOs) (mandatory)
  + Willingness and ability to travel to the US 2–3 times per year (valid passport required; US visa or visa eligibility strongly preferred)
  + Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project)
  + PMP, SAFe, or other relevant certifications preferred

**Key Competencies**

* + Strategic thinking and planning
  + Team management and people leadership
  + Relationship-building with team members, clients, and senior client executives
  + US healthcare domain fluency and client empathy
  + Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills
  + Effective communication and stakeholder management
  + Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
  + Financial and budget management expertise
  + Risk management and conflict resolution

**What Success Looks Like — Your First 12 Months**

**We have clear expectations for this role. Here is what we expect the first year to look like:**

**First 30 Days**

* + Develop a clear understanding of the organization, our projects, and where we stand today
  + Understand the finances of the company and our overall operating picture
  + Complete introductions across the teams and build a foundational understanding of how we work
  + Get assigned to a blue-chip customer and begin understanding what we are doing and what the priorities are
  + Begin improving the weekly and monthly reporting to that customer
  + Put together a plan to completely take over that account from the existing team member and reduce the existing leader's responsibilities

**By 60 Days**

* + Take ownership of our innovation pipeline assess how you would run it and get to know the current team members
  + Establish how we measure the productivity we gain from AI, and how we demonstrate those gains to end customers as clear proof of value

**By 90 Days**

* + Move into our tier-2 projects and optimize weekly and monthly reporting, customer satisfaction, regular touch-bases and updates to the leadership team, and resource planning
  + Complete a resource assessment — what we have, and what we need to hire or replace
  + Define how to accelerate the innovation pipeline to produce more qualified leads, proofs of concept (POCs), and proofs of value (POVs), in closer alignment with the sales and marketing teams

**By 12 Months**

* + A well-oiled engineering and delivery organization
  + Approximately 65% overall margin across the entire portfolio
  + A bench maintained at approximately 15%, also used for innovation and POC/POV projects
  + Measurable outcomes delivered from the innovation pipeline
  + Heavy, pervasive use of AI across the team every team member actively using AI in their daily work

title: Technical Project Lead
description:
**Job Description**

**Position:** Technical Project Manager**Experience:** 7+ Years**Job Type:** Full-Time**Work Mode:** Work From Office

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Technical Project Manager** to lead software development projects and manage international client relationships. The ideal candidate should have excellent project management, client communication, and leadership skills, along with strong technical knowledge of **WordPress, Shopify, Full Stack Development, Mobile Applications, Backend Technologies, Cloud Platforms, and AI-based Projects**.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Manage end-to-end software development projects from planning to deployment.

· Handle international client communication, requirement gathering, and project delivery.

· Lead and manage a team of **5–10 developers**, QA engineers, designers, and mobile developers.

· Coordinate WordPress, Shopify, Full Stack, AI, and Mobile Application projects.

· Plan project timelines, sprint planning, resource allocation, and risk management.

· Monitor project progress, quality assurance, and production deployment.

· Review technical architecture, backend solutions, APIs, and database design.

· Ensure timely delivery, client satisfaction, and high-quality project execution.

· Prepare project documentation, reports, and status updates.

**Required Skills**

· 7+ years of experience in Technical Project Management.

· Strong experience working with **international clients**.

· Excellent English communication and presentation skills.

· Hands-on knowledge of **WordPress, Shopify, PHP, Laravel, React.js, Next.js, Node.js, REST APIs, AI Projects, Mobile Applications, Backend Development, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, Git, CI/CD, AWS/Azure/GCP**, and basic DevOps.

· Strong understanding of **SDLC, Agile/Scrum, Jira, ClickUp, Trello, or similar project management tools**.

· Experience managing AI-based applications, SaaS platforms, CRM/ERP systems, E-commerce platforms, and cloud-based applications.

· Strong leadership, stakeholder management, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

·

**Qualifications**

· Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

· PMP, Scrum Master, or Agile Certification is an added advantage.

**Preferred Candidate**

· Experience managing **5–10 member development teams**.

· Proven experience handling international projects from requirement gathering to deployment.

· Strong backend and system architecture knowledge.

· Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and deliver scalable technical solutions.

Experience:

* IT project management: 5 years (Required)
* Client services: 5 years (Required)
* Full-stack development: 3 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹150,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Full-stack development: 4 years (Required)
* IT project management: 3 years (Required)
* Node.js: 3 years (Required)
* Microsoft SQL Server: 4 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person
